description: A woman in a pale bonnet and shawl sits at a dark wooden table lit by a single candle in a brass holder, writing with a quill on a folded sheet of paper with scribbled lines. A window on the left shows bare trees and a moon, a barn is visible through a window on the right, and an open book, a small ink pot and a sand box sit on the table. The style is a dim, painterly oil look with no frame and no visible text.
